evidence_items.explanation: Cruise described monitoring and remote help for unforeseen circumstances; Waymo separately described remote assistance while retaining automated driving control. This establishes the human-support arrangement for the two named operators, not for every public-road system.

Waymo expressly distinguished remote assistance from performance of the driving task. This earlier document explains why human backup does not by itself establish that a car is remotely driven or continuously supervised.
